name: Yuuma
source:
An individual under Tatebayashi's command who possesses supernatural powers. 
He is not originally a military man, but has become Tatebayashi's subordinate for a certain purpose. Shigure has a deep-seated grudge against him and attacks him at every opportunity. 

"Understood. I won't kill him."
